events.title: Joan of Arc is cleared of heresy 25 years after her death
events.description: A retrial authorised by Pope Callixtus III quashed Joan of Arc's 1431 conviction and declared her innocent. She was canonised as a saint in 1920.
events.html: A retrial authorised by Pope Callixtus III quashed Joan of Arc's 1431 conviction and declared her innocent. She was canonised as a saint in 1920.

events.title: American rearguard fights the British at Hubbardton
events.description: Retreating from Fort Ticonderoga, an American rearguard fought pursuing British and German troops at Hubbardton, Vermont. Though defeated, they slowed Burgoyne's advance towards eventual surrender at Saratoga.

events.title: President McKinley signs the resolution annexing Hawaii
events.description: McKinley signed the Newlands Resolution, annexing the Republic of Hawaii five years after American businessmen had overthrown Queen Liliuokalani. Hawaii became a US territory and, in 1959, the 50th state.
events.html: McKinley signed the Newlands Resolution, annexing the Republic of Hawaii five years after American businessmen had overthrown Queen Liliuokalani. Hawaii became a US territory and, in 1959, the 50th state.

events.title: Marco Polo Bridge Incident sparks war between China and Japan
events.description: A night-time clash between Japanese and Chinese troops at the Marco Polo Bridge near Beijing escalated into full-scale war. The Second Sino-Japanese War merged into the Second World War and cost millions of Chinese lives.
events.html: A night-time clash between Japanese and Chinese troops at the Marco Polo Bridge near Beijing escalated into full-scale war. The Second Sino-Japanese War merged into the Second World War and cost millions of Chinese lives.

events.title: Boris Becker, 17, becomes Wimbledon's youngest men's champion
events.description: Unseeded West German Boris Becker beat Kevin Curren in four sets to win Wimbledon at 17. He remains the youngest men's singles champion in the tournament's history.
events.html: Unseeded West German Boris Becker beat Kevin Curren in four sets to win Wimbledon at 17. He remains the youngest men's singles champion in the tournament's history.

events.title: Suicide bombers kill 52 on London's transport network
events.description: Four bombers struck three Underground trains and a bus during the morning rush hour, killing 52 people. It was Britain's deadliest terrorist attack since Lockerbie, a day after London won the 2012 Olympics.
